rationale: Standard Manichaean cosmological title (rex honoris) — the divinity seated in the seventh firmament who oversees the cosmic wheel and guards the cosmos. Greek βασιλεὺς τιμῆς. ⲡⲧⲁⲓ̈ⲟ = 'honor, dignity' (Coptic ⲧⲁⲉⲓⲟ).
ⲧⲣⲟⲭⲟⲥ (Greek τροχός 'wheel') + ⲉⲧϣⲟⲟⲡ ('that exists/is'). The cosmic Wheel of the Three Wheels (fire/water/wind) in Manichaean cosmology, here associated with the King of Honor's vigilance.

ⲭⲧⲁⲩ = Lyc. for ϥⲧⲟⲟⲩ 'four' + ⲛⲍⲱⲃ 'of the works.' The Four Works of the Third Ambassador — manifestation of his image, opening of all gates of the firmaments, drawing forth of light, and revelation in the perfection of the Christ-men.
Lycopolitan reflex of Sahidic ⲟⲩⲱⲧⲃ̄ 'pass over, transfer, be elevated.' In context of the four works being manifested, used in elevated/exalted sense.
ⲙⲁⲍⲥⲁϣⲭ = Lyc. ordinal 'seventh' (= Sah. ⲙⲉϩⲥⲁϣϥ̄) + ⲥⲧⲉⲣⲉⲱⲙⲁ (Greek στερέωμα). The highest of the seven firmaments where the King of Honor is enthroned.
